analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (55,060 KRW) vs SMA5 (62,523 KRW)/SMA20 (70,094 KRW)/SMA50 (92,843 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100 (116,916 KRW)/SMA200 (113,065 KRW): long-term trend strength is very weak.
· 52-week position (8.0%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.7→31.0): entering oversold territory, continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1021.6646→-673.4408): bearish convergence, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (approaching lower band at 55,495 KRW) + band width at 41.66% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (41,000 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (41,303 KRW).
· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW): potential for trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): confirming weakening trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.77x): contraction in conviction of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): specifying conditions for observation.
